question: What are the last two digits of 19^(19¹⁹)?
solution: 19⁵ ends in 99 (i.e. −1), so 19¹⁰ ends in 01 and only the exponent's remainder on division by 10 matters. 19¹⁹ ends in 9, so we need 19⁹ = 19⁵ × 19⁴ → (−1) × 21 = −21 → 79.
questionHi: 19^(19¹⁹) के अंतिम दो अंक क्या हैं?
solutionHi: 19⁵ के अंतिम अंक 99 (यानी −1), अतः 19¹⁰ के 01 और केवल घातांक का 10 से शेष मायने रखता है। 19¹⁹ का इकाई अंक 9, अतः 19⁹ = 19⁵ × 19⁴ → (−1) × 21 = −21 → 79।

question: What are the last two digits of 94⁹⁴?
solution: 94 = 100 − 6, and 94 is an even power, so 94⁹⁴ ends like 6⁹⁴. From 6² on, powers of 6 end in 36, 16, 96, 76, 56 and repeat every 5; 94 = 5 × 18 + 4, the same place as 6⁴ = 1296 → 96.

solution: 7⁴ = 2401. Then 7²⁰ = 2401⁵ ends like 1 + 5 × 400 = 2001 → 001 (only the first two terms of (1 + 2400)⁵ matter for the last three digits). So 7¹⁰⁰ = (7²⁰)⁵ ends in 001.

question: What are the last two digits of 2^(2¹⁰⁰)?
solution: For exponents of 2 or more, 2^n's last two digits repeat every 20, so we need 2¹⁰⁰ on division by 20. 2¹⁰⁰ is a multiple of 4 and 2¹⁰⁰ = 16²⁵ leaves 1 on division by 5; the number below 20 like that is 16. So 2^(2¹⁰⁰) ends like 2¹⁶ = 65536: 36.
questionHi: 2^(2¹⁰⁰) के अंतिम दो अंक क्या हैं?
solutionHi: 2 या अधिक घातांक के लिए 2^n के अंतिम दो अंक हर 20 पर दोहराते हैं, अतः 2¹⁰⁰ का 20 से शेष चाहिए। 2¹⁰⁰, 4 का गुणज है और 2¹⁰⁰ = 16²⁵ का 5 से शेष 1; 20 से छोटी ऐसी संख्या 16 है। अतः 2^(2¹⁰⁰) के अंतिम अंक 2¹⁶ = 65536 जैसे: 36।
